Visitor skips at element_start level removes entire subtree

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorElementStartSkipEntireSubtree struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorElementStartSkipEntireSubtree) VisitElementStart(ctx htmd.NodeContext) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorElementStartSkipEntireSubtree{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<div><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></div>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
